method: Native Bonsai on one lowest-ProteinEBM-energy model per assigned cluster plus explicit low-energy unassigned examples, using accepted 4096-dimensional all-pair sketch rows; all nonzero PCA axes; no whitening or variance scaling. The sketch approximates exact all-pair Euclidean distances.
scope: DOC1Rdimer_CDK2 · core · knn; lowest full-complex ProteinEBM Model 6 t=0.10 energy per assigned cluster and up to five low-energy unassigned examples; active full/core geometry only. Energy selection does not imply structural centrality.
